source_refs.note: Mode of Fluoroquinolones Action:: a main subheading of 23.2.3 Fluoroquinolones, its own page (owner 2026-11-04); PDF 211-211.

items: Bactericidal Effect: Fluoroquinolones trap the enzymes involved in DNA replication, creating a complex that causes double-strand DNA breaks. This prevents the bacteria from multiplying and forces them to die, so it classified as bactericidal (kills bacteria).
Targeting Topoisomerases: Fluoroquinolones enter the bacterial cells and inhibit their Type II topoisomerases.
Targeting Topoisomerase IV: Primarily targeted in Gram-positive bacteria, it stops the separation of replicated DNA.
Targeting DNA Gyrase: Primarily targeted in Gram-negative bacteria, it stopping the process of DNA uncoiling during replication.
